title: Correct path difference expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the path difference as Δx = |(10 - x) - x| or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Constructive interference condition
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the condition for constructive interference (maximum amplitude) as Δx = (2n+1)λ/2, correctly noting the waves have opposite initial vibration directions.

title: Destructive interference condition
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the condition for destructive interference (minimum amplitude) as Δx = nλ, correctly noting the waves have opposite initial vibration directions.

title: Maximum amplitude positions
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must list the equilibrium positions x = 3 m and x = 7 m within the figure's range.

title: Minimum amplitude positions
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must list the equilibrium positions x = 1 m, 5 m, and 9 m within the figure's range.

title: Sign error in phase
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the standard constructive condition Δx = nλ, ignoring the π phase difference from opposite initial vibration directions.

title: Range and integer selection
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly solve for integer n such that the resulting x values lie within the visible range of the figure (implied to be 0 to 10 m).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The working shows consistent use of units (meters, seconds) and correctly uses the given wavelength (8 m) and wave speed.
